content.short: International money app for immigrants with accounts and transfers.
content.description: LemFi is an international money app built for immigrants and diaspora communities who need to send money home and manage finances across borders. From a single app, users can hold multi-currency balances, open local-style accounts, and send fast, low-cost transfers to families and businesses across Africa, Asia, Latin America, and other regions from hubs like the UK, Europe, and North America. LemFi focuses on the specific pain points of migrants — expensive remittances, limited banking access, and clunky FX — by offering transparent rates and quick payouts to bank accounts and mobile wallets. By combining accounts and cross-border transfers tailored to immigrant corridors, LemFi positions itself as a financial home for people building lives between countries.
content.meta: LemFi is a money app for immigrants offering multi-currency accounts and transfers. Discover LemFi and other Neobanks on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
